scope: Existing terminal receipt and failure records, including archived claim history. Statuses are recorded write outcomes, not independent verification of project outcomes.
sanitization: Allowlist projection only. No readback, authorization fields or paths, target IDs, claim IDs, controller IDs, evidence, reasons, or secrets. Two long action descriptions generalized to bounded-orgo-launch-and-restore.
future_records: Append one sanitized terminal record per newly completed or failed controller write to receipts.jsonl; refresh manifest counts and checksum. Missing source values remain null or absent; never invent timestamps.
